profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Fuel Cycle
profile.summary: Senior software engineer with 25-year background in IT industry. Broad knowledge of Java EE, Spring framework, Hibernate, MySQL and Oracle.

positions.title: Senior Java Analyst / Developer
positions.description:
Design, development and maintenance of two web applications integrated with other institution applications. One of the applications manages the inventory for Spanish National Research Council (CSIC), public institution dedicated to research and belonging to the Spanish Ministry of Economy and Competitiveness. It is developed using SCRUM agile methodology. The other application manages the bank accounts and bank balance for Spanish National Research Council (CSIC). It is also developed using SCRUM agile methodology.

Skills: Java EE 1.6 and 1.7, Oracle 11, Spring Framework 3, JBoss, Software programming/analyst, Hibernate, JSF / Java Server Faces, PrimeFaces, PostgreSQL 9, Apache Tomcat, JUnit Framework, REST API (JSON, XML), JasperReports, HTML and Web Development.

positions.title: Senior Java Analyst / Developer
positions.description:
Design, development and maintenance of a web application to manage the inventory for Spanish National Research Council (CSIC), public institution dedicated to research and belonging to the Spanish Ministry of Economy and Competitiveness. The application is integrated with other institution applications.

Skills: Java EE 1.6, Oracle 10, Spring Framework 2, JBoss, Software programming/analyst, Hibernate, JSF / Java Server Faces, Apache Tomcat, JUnit Framework, JasperReports, HTML and Web Development.

projects.title: Gestión del Servicio de Habilitación - Consejo Superior de Investigaciones Científicas (CSIC)
projects.description:
Análisis, diseño, desarrollo y mantenimiento de la aplicación para la gestión de las cuentas bancarias y de los pagos de nóminas y a proveedores.Integración con otras aplicaciones internas (Contabilidad, Nóminas…). Metodología ágil Scrum.

Base tecnológica: Java EE, JBoss, Spring Framework, PostgreSQL, Oracle, Hibernate, PrimeFaces, JUnit, JasperReports , Alfresco.

projects.title: Gestión de Patrimonio - Consejo Superior de Investigaciones Científicas (CSIC)
projects.description:
Análisis, diseño, desarrollo y mantenimiento de la aplicación para la gestión del Patrimonio de bienes inmuebles, históricos y no fungibles. Integración con otras aplicaciones (Contabilidad, Facturación…). Metodología ágil Scrum.

Base tecnológica: Java EE, JBoss, Spring Framework, Oracle, Hibernate, JSF, JUnit, JasperReports, A4J, XHTML 1.1, CSS, Javascript, Alfresco.
